# ECU Files Database

Offline archive of **original OEM ECU files** (ZIP / RAR / ORI / BIN) from the chiptuning.pw database, preserved in case the online source disappears.

**🔍 Search online:** https://darkensvk.github.io/chiptuning.pw_ecu-backup/
Search by ECU number, car, engine code or file name and download the file directly.

Brands: Alfa Romeo, Audi, BMW, Citroen, Opel, Peugeot, Seat, Skoda, Volkswagen.

ECU numbers are extracted automatically from file names:
- Bosch hardware numbers (e.g. `0281010302`, `0261208254`, `0261S01007`)
- VAG part numbers (e.g. `03G906021CG`, `038906019FG`, `03L906018BC`)

For research, reference and archival purposes only. Not for sale or commercial use.

## Repository layout

```
ecu_files_<brand>/     original ECU files
index.html             search page (GitHub Pages)
ecu_index.json         file index used by the search page (generated)
scripts/build.py       regenerates ecu_index.json and the list below
scripts/import_requests.py   downloads files from chiptuning.pw
```

## Contributing

Missing an ECU? Open an issue or a pull request. Please add **original (stock) files only**, put them in the right `ecu_files_<brand>` folder and include the HW / SW number in the file name, e.g.

`VW 2.0TDI CFGB 170HP EDC17C46 03L907309R 03L906018BC 1037524625 9784.zip`

After adding files run `python scripts/build.py` to update the index and this README.
